{{Top|leg}}
The '''Public Safety Department''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in charge of preventing situations that might endanger the public's safety.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the department committed Doctor [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] into the [[Valorum Center]] due to their fears of her qualifications of being able to create a plague.<ref name="O66" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''
